name: phoenix-desk-tools
description: Phoenix 桌面辅助工具 — 根目录 pnpm 命令转发至 web-ui

scripts.test: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:rust && pnpm test:ts && pnpm test:caa && echo '' && echo '📊 测试报告: open test-report/index.html (或 npx serve test-report)'
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C server typecheck && pnpm -C web-ui typecheck
scripts.test:caa: pnpm run test:core && pnpm run test:web
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --locked --manifest-path server/fcstd-reader/Cargo.toml && cargo test --locked --manifest-path server/fcstd-xlink/Cargo.toml && cargo test --locked --manifest-path server/cli/Cargo.toml && cargo test --locked --manifest-path server/fcstd-query/Cargo.toml
